verdict.rationale: Attio's REST API supports reading/writing records (attio-docs-2, attio-docs-65), documented rate limiting with 429/Retry-After (attio-docs-32), filtering/sorting to scope syncs (attio-docs-6, attio-docs-31, attio-docs-79), and webhooks with signed payloads for real-time change detection (attio-docs-5, attio-docs-28, attio-docs-80). However, there is no explicit documentation of upsert semantics/endpoints or bulk/batch operations for scale, and no discussion of pagination limits or throughput guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit upsert endpoint documentation, bulk/batch sync endpoints, and scale/performance guidance beyond basic rate-limit headers.
